decisions.boundary_condition: Apply only to flight seat-location selection; do not apply to cabin class, departure time, route choice, lodging, or other travel domains.
decisions.condition: When booking a flight and seat selection is available.
decisions.default_action: Request a window seat for the flight segment being booked.
decisions.exception_condition: If no window seat is available, or the user gives a conflicting seat priority such as accessibility needs, companion seating, or a different explicit seat location, do not force the window-seat default.
decisions.name: Prefer window seats on flights
decisions.rationale: Repeated examples explicitly request a window seat for flight bookings when possible. This is a flight seat-location preference only and contrasts with aisle-seat alternatives, so it should remain separate rather than be merged.

decisions.boundary_condition: Apply only to flight seat-location selection; do not infer preferences about cabin class, airline, route, destination, or travel dates from this habit.
decisions.condition: When selecting seats for a flight and an aisle option is available for the traveler or party.
decisions.default_action: Request an aisle seat by default rather than a window or middle seat.
decisions.exception_condition: If no aisle seat is available, or the user explicitly requests a different seat type for a specific trip, do not force the aisle-seat default.
decisions.name: Prefer aisle seats on flights
decisions.rationale: Repeated examples explicitly request aisle seats for flight bookings when available. This is a flight seat-location preference only and contrasts with window-seat alternatives, so it should remain separate rather than be merged.
